name: Walters State Community College
oos_note: Public JUCO (TN Board of Regents). Official tuition page (ws.edu/cost-aid/tuition-fees) publishes out-of-state rate only per-credit-hour: $331/credit hour up to 12 credit hours (capped) for 2025-26; no annual total is published. Computed on same full-time basis as in-state $5,154: out-of-state maintenance $331 x 12 x 2 semesters = $7,944 + mandatory fees $312/yr (matches cost-of-attendance fees figure) = $8,256. Source: ws.edu tuition & fees page, 2025-26.
